In the `a > 0xff` (`OP_EXT1`) branch, `genjmp2()` writes the raw 16-bit `pc` value into the jump-link field instead of calling `gen_jmpdst(s, pc)`. That violates the link-format contract later assumed by `dispatch()` and `dispatch_linked()`.
